title: Small Object Detection via Coarse-to-fine Proposal Generation and Imitation Learning (CFINet)
abstract: Two-stage framework for small object detection: Coarse-to-fine RPN (CRPN) for dense small-object proposals + Feature Imitation (FI) branch with auxiliary imitation loss (supervised contrastive). Integrated with Faster R-CNN, achieves SOTA on SODA-D / SODA-A. Strongest novelty-overlap with our hypothesis: the FI branch is a training-time auxiliary signal targeted at small-object regions.
verify_note: Verified via WebSearch on openaccess.thecvf.com + arxiv.org; abstract content confirmed.

title: Contrastive Learning through Auxiliary Branch for Video Object Detection (CLAB)
abstract: Contrastive auxiliary branch with contrastive loss to enhance backbone feature representation for video object detection. Branch is discarded during inference; no extra inference cost. Pattern is exactly the train-vs-inference asymmetry of our proposal (modality differs: VOD vs single-image).
verify_note: Title + mechanism confirmed via WebSearch on arxiv.org; author list TODO via WebFetch on abs page.

title: QueryDet: Cascaded Sparse Query for Accelerating High-Resolution Small Object Detection
abstract: Two-stage detector: first predicts coarse locations on low-res features, then sparse queries to high-res features for accurate detection. Improves COCO mAP_small by 2.0 and VisDrone SOTA at the time. Differs from us in: sparse query mechanism (vs our dense aux supervision); inference cost (theirs retains both stages; ours drops aux at inference).
verify_note: Verified via WebSearch on openaccess.thecvf.com + arxiv.org; mechanism details + author list confirmed.

title: Slicing Aided Hyper Inference and Fine-tuning for Small Object Detection (SAHI)
abstract: Generic slicing pipeline: overlapping image patches → per-patch detector inference → merge. Geometric, no training-time aux branch. Inference-time mechanism only. Increases AP +6.8/+5.1/+5.3 on FCOS/VFNet/TOOD; +12.7/+13.4/+14.5 with fine-tuning. Closest in motivation, different in mechanism.
verify_note: Title + mechanism confirmed via WebSearch on arxiv.org; SAHI is well-known open-source framework.

title: Mr. DETR: Instructive Multi-Route Training for Detection Transformers
abstract: Multi-route training for DETR-family detectors: aux routes (one-to-many) used at training, discarded at inference. Same train-vs-inference asymmetry pattern as our proposal, different architecture family (DETR vs our Faster R-CNN baseline).
verify_note: Title + mechanism confirmed via WebSearch; author list TODO via WebFetch on abs page.

title: RT-DETRv3: Real-time End-to-End Object Detection with Hierarchical Dense Positive Supervision
abstract: Hierarchical dense positive supervision: multiple aux branches during training improve performance + convergence, no inference latency added. Same family as Mr. DETR (DETR-side, aux-branch-dropped-at-inference). Differs from us in: DETR family vs Faster R-CNN baseline; dense positive supervision vs region-aware ROI supervision.
verify_note: Title + mechanism confirmed via WebSearch; author list TODO.

title: MGDFIS: Multi-scale Global-detail Feature Integration Strategy for Small Object Detection
abstract: Multi-scale feature integration strategy. Faster R-CNN+MGDFIS achieves 33.4% mAP on VisDrone, +2% over baseline; +12.5% AP50 on Faster R-CNN. June 2025 — our most recent VisDrone Faster-R-CNN-compatible SOTA reference.
verify_note: Numbers confirmed via WebSearch; author list TODO.

title: RemDet: Rethinking Efficient Model Design for UAV Object Detection
abstract: UAV-focused efficient detector. SOTA on VisDrone with +3.4% mAP, 110 FPS on a single 4090. Comparable hardware to our 2× RTX Pro 6000 budget — confirms 3-month timeline is realistic.
verify_note: Verified via WebSearch; concrete numbers extracted.

title: Small Object Detection: A Comprehensive Survey on Challenges (March 2025)
abstract: Recent comprehensive survey of small object detection. Reference for: SOTA landscape snapshot, taxonomy of approaches (incl. coarse-to-fine, query-guided, multi-scale, attention-based). Use to bound the related-work draft scope.
verify_note: Survey; use for related-work scoping, not for novelty comparison.

title: Better Sampling, towards Better End-to-end Small Object Detection
abstract: Sampling-strategy variant; end-to-end. Aux signal candidate (sampling rebalancing vs our region-aware aux). Worth screening for ablation comparison.

title: SUPERSEDED — Object-Aware Aggregation Network (OAN) was hallucinated
abstract: Earlier LLM-seed entry claimed OAN (Yang et al. 2022, ECCV) as the closest neighbour. WebSearch on arxiv.org + openaccess.thecvf.com (queries: 'object-aware aggregation network small object detection aerial OAN', 'OAN object aware aggregation network Yang patent aerial 2022 ECCV') returned zero matching results. The actual closest neighbour is CFINet (cand_0011) which has a Feature Imitation BRANCH + auxiliary imitation loss + small object focus + Faster R-CNN baseline. This row records the falsification for audit trail.
verify_note: FALSIFIED 2026-05-18 via WebSearch. The mechanism we wanted to compare against actually lives in cand_0011 (CFINet) — that's the row to use for the novelty-critic pass.
